title: Targeted training
summary: Admission under a contract with a future employer.

body.text: Targeted training allows applicants to study under a contract with an employer and secure a job after graduation.

items: Find an employer and sign a targeted training contract.
Apply to the university within the deadlines.
Compete for a targeted quota place.

body.text: The list of employers and available places is published by the admissions office.
